content: Amisye anajo indamu Po kakai rasakinavo marova mai
Ransyerano Israel ukiny dai arono wanya usea no Yavar Amisy no Yerusalem.

content.text: ‘‘Wama marova wo wansansuimbe no arono manasyine wea ndea naiso.’’
Omamo syare vatano Israel wapo raura nakato, wapare:
‘‘Wama marova wo wansansuimbe no arono manasyine wea ndea naiso,
Wo wansanepati ti pare ntuna wansakiri mona so rai janyi,
maisyare vatane wo kopa rakarore ravabari ti ngkaipiti wemaisy.
Po wansapaya vatano mamune awa vambunine rai to.’’
koveamo Nyo mapinde indamu wansuk akirive usamane.
Koveamo onawamo maisyare insumai ntubai no manyume von,
arono ntubai kaijoe, vatane wo rapatin akato ti mewen.
Insumai umaso mo ininai ntubai no nawaisye ramaisy,
vatane wo raugave ramu yara wo rapatin ti ntuna vayave.
Weti vemo vatane inta ube arakobe mai jinya,
vemo wo kove raura mai jinya, muno vemo usambayambe mai nora.

footnotes.text: Ayao Ibrani maisyare so: ‘‘Po inapaya irati vatano mamun awa kaijo waije rai.’’ Arono vatano Israel una no munijo aroo Mesir, vatano mamune wo kaijo waije veano vatano Israel manepato mansakiri mona rai, wo mansantitidi mangkebe awa anakere rai.
Unato Sion no no Yerusalem, Yavaro Amisye ntuna rije.
Arono wusyinoe vatano Israel awa yavare mamo yavaro oram ama vone mavae vayave muno kopa ntuna rai, weti intanamo insumai ntubai rai.
